capabilities: Create, start, stop, and restart timers from the command palette
Show the current timer and its duration in the status bar
Summarize the day's tracked time in a side panel
Render time tracking reports inside notes using code blocks
extras: The full tutorial and reference for rendering time reports lives in the plugin wiki, not the README; the author notes it depends on an external JavaScript library for the Toggl API.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track time spent on tasks or pull timer data from a time tracking service.

relations.evidence: The developer of the QuickAdd plugin has created a preset menu for timers using QuickAdd.

summary: Toggl Track API integration that lets you start, stop, and monitor timers and render time tracking reports in notes.
